name: smwgraphics-smw-graphics-remoderation-removal-archive
title: SMW Graphics Remoderation Removal Archive
description:
This download contains most of the files removed during the section remoderation from 2013-2015. If you're looking for a file that was removed, it should be here. Unfortunately not all files were saved during the remoderation, but a good portion were.

Bear in mind that these files were probably removed for a good reason and they may not be that useable.

Regardless, have fun!
